corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Independent scientific advice substantively addresses responsible AI uptake in science, research infrastructure, data and models, funding, researcher skills and research assessment.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Original first edition admitted using the independently verified Commission release of 15 April 2024 plus clearly labelled ALLEA and KNAW institutional archive supplements. Original issue date, imprint, identifiers and text are read from those preserved copies, not a newly recovered EU-hosted original PDF. Both are 102 PDF pages; their extracted text agrees page by page although their bytes differ. The opinion is non-binding independent advice, not an adopted Commission strategy. DG RTD support and Publications Office publication are distinct from GCSA authorship. SAPEA Evidence Review Report No. 13 supports this opinion but is a separate work, not its original edition or an official correction notice. Classification is an AI-assisted research assessment. Publication cutoff remains 2026-09-04.
